derivation.advance: For |phase|<2, Float32 rounding error of phase+reciprocal is <=2^-24. Delta=Float32(1/period)-2^-24 remains positive.
derivation.initial_state: assign_defaults initializes phase/value0; detached warmup runs default interval441,width.25. interval/width setters only assign and do not reset phase/value. Cold and warmed/default states are bounded in[-1,1].
derivation.purpose: Only stationary duty/rising-spacing property measurements discard this source-derived prefix. Full-window property failures remain visible; all samples remain in exact Float32/PCM comparisons. This is not an absolute-phase truth oracle.
derivation.scope: Finite scalar interval16..2048,width0..1, exclusive owner, RNE Float32; existing branch/state policy unchanged.
derivation.window: At most2 phase units from bounded initial state reach the next falling threshold; ceil(2/delta)+2 covers that plus the low->high step order. Width0/1 output is immediate and has no settling exclusion.

kernel_state_counterexample.qualification: Arithmetic/state example only; actual C ABI reachability of this exact state is not asserted.

retained_semantic_limitations.limit: Source-derived prefix is used only for native stationary duty/edge properties at the original tolerance. Every sample remains in pair comparison; baseline startup failure is retained.

historical_restoration.scope: Actual GUIv3 recovery at this historical run only. Later GUI installs/disconnection/nonRNBO firmware are outside this record; no current device state is inferred.
